subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Valkyries of the Slain
description: A short lesson to help you apply Valkyries of the Slain.

hook.text: Valkyries flew over battlefields choosing which warriors would die. Death was selected, not random.

buildup.text: Chosen warriors went to Valhalla to feast and fight until Ragnarök. Death in battle was a promotion.

discovery.text: Valkyries served mead in Valhalla. Warrior women who chose death also served the glorious dead at table.

twist.text: Only the worthy were chosen. Dying in battle wasn't enough—you had to fight bravely. Cowards went to Hel.

climax.text: Valkyries fused death, honor, and femininity. Female figures controlled the ultimate male fate.

quiz.question: What did the Valkyries do on the battlefield?
options: Chose which warriors would die and go to Valhalla
